name: omnibridge/laravel
description: The Laravel host of omnisense/omnibase: its Foundation contracts (urls, translations, locales, access, parameters with the database settings laid over Laravel's config, clock, events...) answered by Laravel's services and seeded in Base\Contract\Runtime, Doctrine through omnibridge/doctrine, Twig through omnibridge/twig, and the pieces an omnibase page asks of its framework (Encore tags, the app variable, simple forms).

suggest.omnibridge/static: Static\BuildCommand: php artisan omnibridge:static:build, omnibridge/static's export of the site a static.php declares, rendered by the application's HTTP kernel
suggest.omnisense/omniauth: Omnibridge\Laravel\Auth\: Laravel's guard and user provider over omniauth, one controller for every way of signing in (password, sign-in link, e-mailed code, backup codes, trusted devices), the second factor's page, the routes; config/omnibridge.php 'auth' => true and config/omniauth.php (nothing of Auth\ without it)
suggest.omniauth/webauthn: Passkeys through Omnibridge\Laravel\Auth\ (config/omniauth.php: passkey), formerly omniauth/passkey
suggest.omniauth/otp: Authenticator applications through Omnibridge\Laravel\Auth\ (config/omniauth.php: totp; totp.secret_key seals the secrets at rest), formerly omniauth/totp
suggest.omniauth/google: Google sign-in through Omnibridge\Laravel\Auth\ (config/omniauth.php: oauth.providers.google; its GoogleFactory is used when it is installed)
suggest.omnisense/omnimap: Omnibridge\Laravel\Map\: maps through omnimap (config/omnimap.php) - its providers, the map cache over a directory or a bound Omnimap\Snapshot\Storage, omnibridge/twig's MapExtension in every page's Twig, the tiles' route
suggest.omnisense/omnishield: Omnibridge\Laravel\Shield\: omnishield's Registry from config/omnishield.php (the Symfony bundle's keys), ALTCHA's widget served by the application; with omnibase, its captcha after failed sign-ins (Auth\OmnibaseEffects); not on Packagist yet - a vcs repository, https://github.com/glitchr-omnisense/omnishield
suggest.omnishield/altcha: ALTCHA, the captcha omnibase asks after failed sign-ins: served and checked by the application, no third party
suggest.omnibase/consent: omnibase/consent's cookie answer in the pages (View\OmnibaseExtensions: consent_options(), consent_settings() on config/omnibridge.php's consent.config)
